source_description: Smogon VGC Regulation F 2.0 sample teams published in January/March 2026
spread_caveat: The source thread states that sample EVs may not be the competitors' exact spreads and may use recreations or Smogon Dex analysis spreads. Entries explicitly marked RECREATION by the source are additionally flagged below.

split_policy.training: Published samples selected to expand archetype and mechanic coverage available to self-play.
split_policy.heldout: Four novel, mutually distinct archetypes are withheld from training to test transfer: setup balance, Regidrago psyspam, Neutralizing Gas Dondozo, and hard Trick Room. Existing heldout samples remain held out.
split_policy.deduplication: Exact Showdown packed-team bytes take precedence over the requested split. An existing team is never copied into the other split.
